items.q: That's when we went and got Specs Powell... We'd get him down on 52nd Street and say, 'If you leave we'll throw you off the Brooklyn Bridge. You have to stay.'

ctx.x: J. C. joined Cab, I remember.

He joined Cab. Cozy went to CBS. Now after Cozy stayed there for a while, then they had this big show coming along. The war's going on now. They had this big show coming along. Now me and Sidney said, "Who can we get to play in Cozy's place with Raymond Scott?" That's when we went and got Specs Powell. Specs was leaving for 6 months, he was leaving every night. We'd get him down on 52nd Street and say, "If you leave we'll throw you off the Brooklyn Bridge. You have to stay." He said, "Why don't you all come down…
